kinds.description: Task _type -> kind of work (ode, steady, jacobian, fba) for tasks that a simulator performs; the command line can name a different backend for each kind.

serves.description: Kind -> the backends that belong to it.  A backend that does not serve a task's kind is replaced by the only one that does, when there is exactly one (flux balance analysis: cobra).

tasks.description: Task _type -> backend -> entry. Every listed task has an entry for every backend.

reason.description: Why not.  Required when supported is false.

deferred.description: True if the task is out of scope for now rather than impossible.

verified.description: False while the entry is an expectation that has not been confirmed by running the backend. Default true.

conditions.description: Checked in order; the first whose 'when' matches the task decides, otherwise 'supported' applies.

when.description: Dotted attribute path of the task -> list of values; all paths must match, a path matches if the task's value is any of the listed values (a missing attribute is null).

check.description: Name of a function in capabilities/checks.py for conditions too complex for 'conditions'. It is called after 'conditions' find no match, and may veto a supported task.
